title: Synthetic brand guidelines - Bro World Optician
writingRules: Prefer helpful information over aggressive sales language.
Use a clear call to action without pressure.
prohibited: Do not invent medical advice or health outcomes.
Do not invent prices, discounts, product specifications or certifications.
Do not invent customer testimonials or performance metrics.
Do not imply that AI-generated content has been approved.
visualRules: Prefer natural light and readable contrast.
approval: A human reviewer must approve the exact version before handoff.
